(1) a single non-reactively chosen policy can be used to collect a good contextual dataset for a near-optimal reactive contextual policy and (2) this policy is a simple modification of the UCB1 algorithm.

(a) we propose a novel algorithm for designing a non-reactive policy for exploration in the stochastic contextual linear bandits setting, and (b) we prove that the algorithm is minimax-optimal for a large class of problems and we provide a theoretical analysis of the algorithm in terms of the number of samples required to achieve a given level of performance.
